title: PALs Can Now Enter And Interact in Google Meet
summary: PALs can now join Google Meet. Invite one the way you'd invite any teammate — or drop it into a live call — and it's there as a real participant: on camera, following the conversation, and responding in real time. It can take notes in your team sync, ride along on sales calls, walk a customer through a technical demo, or host your standup, bringing the help into the meetings you already run instead of asking anyone to go somewhere new. It's human computing meeting you where you are, and Google Meet is just the first door — Zoom and Microsoft Teams are next.
